summary: Continue authorized work in a fresh background Claude session using a concise handoff grounded in durable artifacts.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.reason: Make current state, ownership, and next action explicit while keeping durable details behind pointers.
deltas.tradeoff: A slightly longer handoff replaces some of the original minimalism.

deltas.change: Separate launch attempt from successful transfer
deltas.reason: Require a supported runtime, safe prompt transport, and a launch receipt.
deltas.tradeoff: Unsupported environments receive a usable handoff without automatic continuation.

deltas.reason: Name remaining ownership and stop work on the transferred unit after successful launch.
deltas.tradeoff: Concurrency is reduced at the transfer boundary to protect continuity.

deltas.reason: Do not silently map Claude background jobs to a different provider or user-owned chat.
deltas.tradeoff: A universal-looking command becomes an explicitly conditional capability.

deltas.change: Adapt Codex packaging without changing invocation
deltas.reason: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation and argument-hint keys while preserving explicit-only policy in the copied agents/openai.yaml.
deltas.tradeoff: The study package targets Codex metadata rather than being a byte-identical cross-host manifest.
